span.p:
01 · Intent Firewall
─────────────────────
Blocks: rm -rf · domain escalation
script injection · malformed payloads
━━ Fail-closed · explicit deny reasons

div.style: color: rgb(240, 200, 154) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
02 · Risk Engine
─────────────────────
Signals: value · velocity · recipient novelty
burst behavior · cross-domain flags
━━ Score: 0 – 100

div.style: color: rgb(240, 200, 154) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
03 · Policy Engine
─────────────────────
0–39 → ALLOW
40–69 → ALERT + Telegram notify
70–100 → REQUIRE APPROVAL or BLOCK
━━ Hash-verified policy bundle

div.style: color: rgb(240, 200, 154) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
04 · Telegram Governance
─────────────────────
Operators: /approve · /freeze · /resume
━━ Human-in-the-loop gate
━━ Fail-closed if Telegram unavailable

div.style: color: rgb(240, 200, 154) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
05 · Policy Integrity & Audit
─────────────────────
SHA-256 re-hash on every startup
Walrus decentralized audit write
━━ No proof → no execution
